links.outcome: Algorithmic fairness metrics of PRS-augmented CVD risk prediction across age, sex, ethnicity, and deprivation subgroups
links.effect: PRS as a stand-alone factor showed fairness similar to or better than traditional predictors. Some variation across ethnic groups appeared at extreme thresholds. As a risk enhancer for intermediate-risk individuals, PRS had minimal impact on fairness metrics.
links.quote: Some variation in fairness was observed across ethnic groups, especially at extreme risk thresholds.

screen.reason: Evaluates equity and algorithmic fairness metrics (e.g., equal opportunity, treatment equality) when integrating polygenic risk scores into existing clinical risk prediction (QRISK3) across diverse demographic subgroups.

primary.practice: algorithmic fairness evaluation across demographic subgroups
